author: agent
objective: Among residents of the 96 mainland French departments, what is the adjusted association between department-average 1999–2016 annual PM2.5 and cumulative in-hospital COVID-19 deaths on 1 May 2020?

scientific_invariants.research_question: Among residents of the 96 mainland French departments, what is the adjusted association between department-average 1999–2016 annual PM2.5 and cumulative in-hospital COVID-19 deaths on 1 May 2020?
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: Cumulative in-hospital COVID-19 deaths on 1 May 2020 among residents of 96 mainland French departments; department population is the offset.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Mortality rate ratio per 1 µg/m³ increase in department-average long-term PM2.5 (1999–2016).
principal_variants: Continuous PM2.5 model on 2020-05-01, adjusted for long-term temperature, health-service, socio-demographic, spatial, and diabetes covariates; article also reports analogous monthly dates and PM2.5-quartile model.

article_evidence.finding: Primary estimand, full adjustment set, variants, citations, and contract discrepancy are extracted from the complete local article.
